title: Formal low derivatives equal transverse and coefficient derivatives
statement:
Let L be a characteristic-zero field and m,n,s natural numbers. For alpha_i in N^n, let every transverse variable occur with positive exponent in some alpha_i [def-trf-supported-homogeneous-division]. Let c_{i,gamma} be arbitrary series in L[[W]] and f_i in L[[W,Z]] with coefficient identity [W^delta Z^gamma]f_i=[W^delta]c_{i,gamma} [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. For each degree d occurring among |alpha_i|, put E_d={j: some alpha_i with |alpha_i|<=d has alpha_i(j)>0}. Suppose there are indices i(j) and exponents beta_j with alpha_{i(j)}=beta_j+e_j, |alpha_{i(j)}|<=d and g_j=partial_Z^{beta_j} f_{i(j)} in (Z_j:j in E_d); suppose their E_d-Jacobian at zero has unit determinant. With the unnormalized iterated derivatives of [def-trf-formal-power-series-partial-derivative], the low derivative ideal of [lem-trf-formal-hilbert-stratum-minors] satisfies
E=(partial^nu f_i:|nu|<|alpha_i|)=(Z_1,...,Z_n)+(rename(partial_W^delta c_{i,gamma}):|gamma|<|alpha_i|, |delta|<|alpha_i|-|gamma|).
No order, supported division, generating-ideal or scheme hypotheses are required. Empty vertex and variable lists and degree-zero vertices are allowed.

source.place: BM 1997 Theorem 7.14, Remarks 9.1 and 9.5, completion of Theorem 9.6, pp.265--268,275--277,282. Returned step 11. ILO VIII 2.3.11--2.3.13 is the route reference; BM is read online, absent locally. No single Stacks tag states this result.

proof.text: If s=0 essentiality implies n=0, and both ideals vanish. If s>0 choose the maximum vertex degree d. Every Z variable belongs to its essential set. Each selected derivative has derivative degree |alpha_i|-1, hence belongs to E. Apply zero-graph factorization from [lem-trf-formal-transverse-shift-calculus], after reindexing its essential variables, to g_j in (Z). Its constant Jacobian is invertible, so (g_j)=(Z) and (Z) is contained in E. Equivalently allocate each monomial to its first Z factor, obtaining g=UZ, and invert U by the adjugate and its unit determinant.

In the quotient by (Z), compute partial_W^delta partial_Z^gamma f_i=gamma! partial_W^delta c_{i,gamma}. This follows by iterating the coefficient rule for a formal partial derivative: a Z monomial survives evaluation at zero exactly when its exponent is gamma. Split any mixed derivative exponent into its W and Z parts. Its degree is their sum, so the low-derivative bound gives exactly the two displayed strict bounds. Factorials are units in characteristic zero. Thus the images of the two ideals in the quotient agree. Both contain (Z), so pullback from that quotient proves equality. If n=0 the calculation alone suffices. Vertices of degree zero supply no generators on either side.

lean.statement:
theorem formal_lowDerivativeIdeal_eq_coefficients
    {L : Type u} [Field L] [CharZero L] {m n s : ℕ}
    (α : Fin s → Fin n →₀ ℕ)
    (hessential : ∀ l : Fin n, ∃ v : Fin s, 0 < α v l)
    (c : Fin s → (Fin n →₀ ℕ) → MvPowerSeries (Fin m) L)
    (f : Fin s → MvPowerSeries (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) L)
    (hexpansion : ∀ (l : Fin s) (d : (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (f l) =
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.comapDomain.addMonoidHom Sum.inl_injective d)
          (c l (Finsupp.comapDomain.addMonoidHom Sum.inr_injective d)))
    (hblocks : ∀ d : ℕ, (∃ l : Fin s, (α l).degree = d) →
      ∃ (pick : {l : Fin n // essential α d l} → Fin s)
        (β : {l : Fin n // essential α d l} → Fin n →₀ ℕ),
        (∀ l, α (pick l) = β l + Finsupp.single l.val 1 ∧
          (α (pick l)).degree ≤ d ∧
          iteratedPartial (fullVertex m (β l)) (f (pick l)) ∈ transverseIdeal α d) ∧
        IsUnit (Matrix.det (fun l r : {l : Fin n // essential α d l} ↦
          MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (MvPowerSeries.pderiv L (Sum.inr r.val)
            (iteratedPartial (fullVertex m (β l)) (f (pick l))))))) :
    lowDerivativeIdeal α f =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun l : Fin n ↦
        (MvPowerSeries.X (Sum.inr l) : MvPowerSeries (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) L)) ⊔
      Ideal.span {g | ∃ (l : Fin s) (γ : Fin n →₀ ℕ) (δ : Fin m →₀ ℕ),
        γ.degree < (α l).degree ∧ δ.degree < (α l).degree - γ.degree ∧
          g = MvPowerSeries.rename Sum.inl (iteratedPartial δ (c l γ))}
